# Paired WordprocessingML and DrawingML color controls

Original, independently authored control generated by
`python tools/theme_domain_colors_fixture.py`. The repository-owned
`public/fixtures/shape-theme.docx` supplies the package shell; no corpus text,
artwork or embedded fonts are copied. The generator writes deterministic ZIP
metadata and supports `--output` for regeneration outside this directory.

Each of 32 rows uses one theme base and one byte shade. Its four color swatches
are WML cell `themeFillShade`, DrawingML explicit RGB `lumMod` with the byte factor
converted down to a 100000-unit percentage, the same DrawingML transform applied
to a scheme color, and an explicit RGB transform with the percentage rounded up.
The WML fallback is deliberately unrelated `112233`, so a stale fallback cannot
silently masquerade as successful theme resolution. Values include identity,
low modifiers, saturated bases and near-neutral bases. These shade controls do
not certify tint precision or the complete color space.

`native-capture.json` binds the untouched source to a two-page PDF exported by
the reference application. `tools/record_theme_domain_colors.py` independently checks source
and PDF hashes, page dimensions, PDF text label order, filled rectangle geometry,
row alignment and swatch counts before recording vector RGB values. No JPEG
screen sampling is used. Its result is `reference.json`.

Native observations: 24/32 WML shades differ from the paired DrawingML colors;
0/32 explicit RGB versus scheme-color pairs differ; 0/32 floor versus ceil
percentage pairs differ. The latter two findings are limited to these tested
inputs. Our DrawingML conversion matches all these native drawing values. WML
chromatic byte precision remains unresolved and is not fixed by this fixture.
All 32 WML cell colors also agree with the matching inputs in three prior,
independently captured WML run-color controls. The unit suite checks their
source/cases/PDF bindings before comparing the native observations.

Relevant clauses: ECMA-376 Part 1 §17.4.32 `shd` (table cell shading),
§20.1.2.3.29 `schemeClr`, §20.1.2.3.32 `srgbClr`, §20.1.2.3.20 `lumMod`;
the [MS-OI29500 HSL theme-shade implementation notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/office_standards/ms-oi29500/8229a077-7fc8-4fba-96cc-c77b6a4fc768).
Native color differences here establish rendering evidence; they do not imply
that either OOXML domain prescribes a particular intermediate byte rounding.
